questions.q_text: Because Mr. Chang has been busy these days, it's _______ whether he will come to the party.

options.D: inevitable

explanation.translation: 因為張先生最近很忙，所以他是否會來參加派對還很令人懷疑。
explanation.technique: 💡 看到空格後面的 whether (是否)，就知道這件事充滿「不確定性」。選項中只有 doubtful (懷疑的) 帶有不確定的語氣，impossible 語氣太武斷。
explanation.analysis:
(A) unlikely 通常接 to V 或 that 子句。
(B) impossible 語氣太絕對。
(D) inevitable (無可避免的) 語意不符。
explanation.roots: doubt (懷疑) + -ful (充滿...的) → 充滿懷疑的
collocations: it is doubtful whether / that... (令人懷疑是否...)
sentences: It is highly doubtful whether the project will be finished on time. (這項專案能否準時完成令人高度懷疑。)

questions.q_text: I'm quite _______ to the weather in Taiwan, so I think I'll stay here for another year.

options.D: accustomed

explanation.translation: 我相當習慣台灣的天氣，所以我想我會在這裡多待一年。
explanation.technique: 💡 觀察空格後的介系詞 to，以及語意「所以想多待一年」，推斷出是對天氣「習慣」。
explanation.analysis:
(D) be accustomed to + N/Ving，表示「習慣於...」。
(A) devoted to (致力於)，不能說奉獻給天氣。
(B) satisfied 搭配 with。
(C) pleased 搭配 with。
explanation.roots: ac- (朝向) + custom (習慣) + -ed (形容詞字尾) → 習慣於...
sentences: She quickly became accustomed to his strange sleeping schedule. (她很快就習慣了他奇怪的睡眠作息。)

questions.q_text: 對於什麼是最佳的渡假方式，大家都有不同的看法。
questions.answer: People have different opinions on what is the best way to spend a vacation.

explanation.analysis:
【句型分析】
1. 「對...有不同看法」：have different opinions on/about...
2. 疑問詞 what 引導名詞子句當作 on 的受詞。
